title: Kayshon Boutte precedent could help Brendan Sorsby avoid a suspension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kayshon Boutte precedent could help Brendan Sorsby avoid a suspension
sources.description: With quarterback Brendan Sorsby intending to apply for the NFL's supplemental draft, some are watching and waiting to see whether the NFL will welcome him to the ranks of professional football.
